symptom: Found running the doctype suite on Mendix 9.24.30 (no issue filed): every create page / alter page / snippet with a pluggable widget failed to write: "failed to create page: CreatePage: insert: unit …: this Mendix 9.24.30 project cannot store CustomWidgets$WidgetValueType.DefaultType (Mendix 10.15.0+)" ("failed to save modified page" for alter page), while `mxcli check` passed the script
cause: The pluggable widget Type is copied from the embedded 11.6 templates (sdk/widgets/templates/mendix-11.6, augmented from the project's .mpk) and written verbatim whatever the project version. Every CustomWidgets$WidgetValueType in it carries six keys Mendix introduced after 9.24 (mendixmodelsdk 4.116.0 WidgetValueType.versionInfo): SetLabel 10.5, IsLinked and IsMetaData 10.14, DefaultType 10.15, ActionVariables 10.21, AllowUpload 11.8. The property floor drops the empty ones and refuses a value: DefaultType is "None" on all 604 template value types, and IsLinked / IsMetaData / SetLabel are true on the combo box, dropdown sort and data grid filters, ActionVariables non-empty on some, so those were refused next
file: `mdl/backend/modelsdk/widget_pluggable_write.go` (templateFullBSONIDs, widgetTypeForVersion — used by LoadWidgetTemplate and BuildFilterWidget), `modelsdk/canon/propertyfloor.go` (PropertyDeclared)
insight: The Type is the widget package's schema, not anything the statement said, so a newer-version key in it is dropped whatever it holds — at template load, where the version is known — while the floor keeps refusing values in the Object. Studio Pro 9.24.30's WidgetValueType key set (Atlas_Core.LanguageSelectorWidget in a Studio Pro-authored 9.24 app, `mxcli bson dump --type snippet --format ndsl`) is exactly the template's minus those six, so the Model SDK versionInfo is complete for this type and the gate can use the floor's own data (canon.PropertyDeclared) instead of a hand list. codec.Encoder.OmitKeys does not reach it: the Type is decoded from raw bytes, its elements are clean, and the encoder passes clean fields through without consulting OmitKeys. Fixing DefaultType alone would have moved the refusal to IsLinked/SetLabel/ActionVariables; stubbing the gate in the unit test shows all of them at once. Not covered: 9.24 also stores CustomWidgetType.WidgetPhoneGapEnabled (deleted 10.0) that the template lacks (a property-set gap, not a refusal), and the data grid template's sample-column Object holds a 10.2+ Forms$DesignPropertyValue.Value
